summary: The single definition of the site's page-wide background: one fixed body::before carrying a 90deg frost-to-ember ramp (frost at the left edge, ember at the right, transparent 42%-58%), rotating to 180deg below 900px. Every page shell imports it alongside landing.css or docs.css, so one edit here changes home, docs and blog together. It previously held a 30px repeating dot grid; that was replaced because a tiled background pattern is the most common generated-site tell on the web and it also competed for the same z-index -1 layer as the ramp.
